thread:
Ravi: Idea: 'graceful midstream checkpoint' for streaming requests so clients can act on committed fragments and gateway can retry only the remaining window. Thoughts?

Nina: sounds useful. How do you define 'committed' fragment vs just a chunk?

Ravi: committed = fragment marked final by edge when it's semantically stable (not a speculative prefix). Edge emits header `x-redwood-checkpoint: id` when it happens.

Omar: concern: retries and side effects. Checkpoint must not imply server-side commit for actions; idempotency keys still required.

Liu: operationally, need TTL and mode: host-local vs cross-host. default local to keep perf. add metrics: checkpoint.alloc, checkpoint.resume, checkpoint.expire.

Nina: SDKs need a tiny state machine: streaming -> checkpointed -> resumed -> final/aborted. Also guidance for mobile network changes.

Ravi: agree. I'll draft a short appendix with header names, error codes (409/410), and POC plan. @deploy-bot please create feature flag `edge.checkpoints` for canary rollout.

deploy-bot: feature flag `edge.checkpoints` created for org 'engineering'. rollout: staging -> 15% prod. (automated)

Ravi: thanks all — will follow up with RFC appendix.
